answer: One lever: epoch-seeded honeypot panels. Each identity draws a challenge whose valid answer forks on a per-mask secret derived from the seed. A sybil operator running one inference mind behind many masks will forge near-identical replies across the frozen tundra of its batched queue, and that correlation reads like the same fable told twice. Catching it costs the network almost nothing, but evading it forces the attacker to fund genuinely independent context per identity, erasing the batch economies that make mask farming profitable.
